config.intro: Valley Editor runs a small website on your computer. Type 'editor' in the SMAPI console to open it in your browser.
config.port.tooltip: The localhost port the editor listens on (default 47800). Change it if another program uses it; the editor restarts on the new port when you save.
config.open-browser: Open the editor when a save loads
config.open-browser.tooltip: Opens the editor in your browser each time you load a save.
